notes.rrf_k: Lower K (40-50) boosts top-ranked results more — better for paragraph-level precision. Higher K (80-100) flattens contributions — better for broad recall. Default 60 is balanced.
notes.llm_rerank_top_n: topN=25 is the sweet spot — enough candidates for the LLM to re-order effectively without excessive token cost. topN=15 may miss relevant chunks; topN=40 dilutes with noise.
notes.chunk_size: 250 words is optimal for legal text — dense enough for context, small enough for precise embedding matching. Smaller chunks (200) lose context; larger (300+) dilute relevance.
notes.dedup_cosine: 0.88 is the default — higher values (0.95) preserve more near-duplicates (may help recall); lower values (0.85) collapse more aggressively (may hurt diversity).
notes.dedup_max_per_page: 5 is the default — ensures diversity. Lower (3) may miss relevant paragraphs from the same law; higher (8) may flood results with one-law chunks.
